ApiMessageResponse.description: Response wrapper for operations that return only a success flag and message.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type (e.g., "/errors/validation").

title.description: A short human-readable summary of the problem type (e.g., "Validation Error").

status.description: The HTTP status code for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence (typically the request path).

message.description:
Backward-compatible message field. Mirrors 'detail' so existing frontend
code using errorData.message continues to work during migration.

errors.description:
Field-level validation errors. Only present for validation errors.
Key = field name (camelCase), Value = array of error messages.

traceId.description: Trace ID for correlating errors with logs and monitoring.

ApiProblemDetails.description:
RFC 9457 Problem Details response with backward-compatible 'message' field
and optional field-level validation errors.
Standalone class (not extending Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails)
to avoid its custom JsonConverter which would skip derived properties.
